title: Making one non-AI game and several AI games. Will people believe the non-AI one?
author: angry_cactus
selftext:
There's amazing stuff you can do with AI art and I also respect the hustle of making every asset and content from scratch. The anti-AI crowd can be pretty passionate reviewbombing though etc.

If you released a game with hand-painted assets, photographic textures, and a few coding dev logs but you have several (non-slop, very much iterated) AI assisted games polished products for sale. Several free AI prototypey things elsewhere. Will the non-AI one get doubted and get a bunch of negative sentiment?

(I would still use AI for hardware GPU optimization and unit testing though. Insane not to boost framerate with AI keep everything the same optimization pass.)

comments.author: Laicbeias
comments.body:
Ive once rotated the face of my 2d main char 45 degrees sidewards towards the camera. I still get sweaty hands. It took me 8 days. 

They wont believe you. But why bother you can just post your photoshop/illustrator files and their layers? But it wont change anyones mind.

comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body:
Who are you? 

Are you some famous gamedev with a massive following that people pick apart every release you make and write articles and make video essays about?

Don't sweat it man. It's hard to make a good game. There's no guarantee you're non slop game is going to be any good nor is there any guarantee that anyone will even play it. Focus on making a good game, worry about the haters later.

comments.author: benjaminabel
comments.body: Probably, yes. I’ve seen it multiple times already when people go through the developer’s social profiles to find any connections to AI. But these people do not represent everyone, so nobody knows how it will actually go down.

comments.author: Brettinabox
comments.body: Who cares just do it for you

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body: This is the gnarliest A/B test ever

comments.author: amunozo1
comments.body: You people really overthink too much. Make a good game. Enjoy. That's it.

comments.author: Neither_Berry_100
comments.body: I agree with the just make a good game responses. Making successful games is very hard. Whatever you make will likely fail with or without AI. Your biggest mistake is thinking you have a chance to make money off the game in the first place.
